mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which impairs carvedilol clearance and increases risk of cardiogenic shock, arrhythmias, and hypotension in a beta-blocked patient.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (K+, Mg2+), and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation; may require carvedilol dose adjustment or temporary discontinuation if severe renal impairment develops.
